name: St. James Episcopal Church
addr: 424 W State St, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: Such a lovely and welcoming church. I was very lucky to be in the area on this particular Sunday so I was able to experience not only a wonderful service, but the guest musicians who performed a concertthe pervious night but then sang with the choir the next Sunday. I felt right at home and will definitely plan on worshipping here again if the circumstances will allow it.
Gosh, what an amazing church! The grounds are meticulous, the meditation and Memorial Gardens are exquisite…very sweet labyrinth as well!

For everyone born, a seat at the table. You do not need to serve or buy in to anything to be in community, to receive healing. Church hurt? Spiritual struggles? Complicated relationship with Jesus? You'll be right at home. Bring your history. Embrace the mystery. Neurodivergent with sensory and/or social challenges? 8am Sunday service -- no music, fewer people, short duration. Wednesday Celtic Service -- softer music, tranquil, medium attendance. Morning meditation -- sit silently in community 5 days a week with no social obligation. Believer with a deep interest in how faith intersects with science, history, literature, or any number of subjects? You'll not only find well-educated elders who are looking to teach you, but are hungry to learn from you, too.
Very kind people with a homey atmosphere. Great sermon with many great lesson to take away into life. Highly recommend

Wonderful spiritual experience. Congregants warm, friendly, welcoming, nonjudgmental. Church is beautiful, especially the stained glass windows. We attended a newcomers welcome event and were pleased to interact with a variety of interesting, intelligent people. The choir is outstanding.

A fine Episcopal Church with very friendly parishioners and an extremely loving community. Faith and spirituality is outstanding and very open-minded, welcoming ALL PEOPLE. Scott Oxford, the Priest, assisted by Kristi Neal, the Deacon are both excellent celebrants of the Eucharist and outstanding preachers. Monthly is a wonderful children's sermon, gathering the youngsters at the communion rail for a meaningful and easily-understood lesson. The choir, led by director and organist Penny Rose, is quite good. Visit us! We'd love to have you!

As an Episcopal priest that travels on behalf of the Presiding Bishop, I visit more than a hundred churches a year. This congregation always feels like home! Reverend Whelchel speaks from her heart with a compassion and wisdom that calls me to my best self. If you are looking for a faith community, St James Episcopal Church is a beautiful example of the best of the Christian tradition.

St. James Church has been a wonderful discovery, full of love and acceptance of all. I have attended several classes with the Interim Rector Rev. Judith Whelchel, an amazing priest full of love and knowledge and accessibility. When in town I attend their Contemplative Prayer group on Wednesday. I have found members to generally be quality people, some I can now call friends. I am not a member of the church or even an Episcopalian but am very drawn to this Church.

Ms. Smith is the most beautiful person I ever met. Visiting her church let me know that God is still in control. I love the timing and structure of the program at St. James. They start on time and end on time. Happy people are at this church. Amen!

Very friendly people. Everyone is positive and interested in you. Everyone truly believes in living their Christianity by being open and welcoming to all people of all races and to LGBTQ as well. The pastor is great and the music is fantastic.
